scope: Proposition 4.2 of the manuscript “Reconstruction from Milnor K-theory modulo the characteristic” (preprints/Reconstruction-from-Milnor-K-theory-modulo-the-characteristic-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 df8a6b4a54b121c6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let K/k and L/l be finitely generated extensions of algebraically closed fields of characteristic p, both of transcendence degree at least two. For every compatible isomorphism Θ : VK → VL, there is a unique n ∈ F× p such that Ψ = nΘ sends every projective line over Kp onto a projective line over Lp.
